changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.sql: UPDATE player_quests SET status = 'COMPLETED', current_progress = ( SELECT target_count FROM quest_templates WHERE id = player_quests.quest_template_id ), version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1 WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quest_templates quest JOIN player_cleared_locations cleared ON cleared.location_id = quest.target_identifier WHERE quest.id = player_quests.quest_template_id AND quest.quest_type = 'CLEAR_LOCATION' AND cleared.player_id = player_quests.player_id );
